newsitem.title: UK: Japan stocks in London up on Tokyo follow-through.
newsitem.headline: Japan stocks in London up on Tokyo follow-through.

text.p: Japanese stocks were firmer overall on Wednesday after follow-through buying from Tokyo, dealers said.
"There's been a huge change in sentiment. It's amazing what 24 hours can do and people are coming in to buy stocks like Muppets (puppets) after the stocks have already gone up," said a dealer.
Banks continued to see good buying interest, dealers said, with Fuji Bank 10 yen ahead at 1,520 yen.
"Most banks are up around 5-10 yen," said a dealer.
Domestic issues were in demand also with ship builder Kawasaki Heavy up seven yen at 487 yen and Mitsubishi Heavy up five yen at 822 yen.
